stemText: The elevation in boiling point of a solution containing $1\,\text{mol}$ of a non-volatile, non-electrolyte solute in $1\,\text{kg}$ of water is given by $\Delta T_b = K_b \times m$, where $m$ is the molality. If $K_b = 0.52\ \text{K kg mol}^{-1}$, calculate $\Delta T_b$ in Kelvin.

solution.explanationText: Molality m = 1 mol / 1 kg = 1 mol/kg. So $\Delta T_b = K_b \times m = 0.52 \times 1 = 0.52\ \text{K}$.
